Package com.tonic.analysis.source.editor

Class ASTEditor

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.source.editor.ASTEditor
  • public class ASTEditor
extends Object
    Fluent editor that walks a method body, dispatching registered handlers to rewrite AST nodes.
